info.title: warte agent API
info.description: Machine-readable answers for agents, from the ground station's latest snapshot. Read-only. The ground station's own API (ETA, state, history, reports) is under /ci; see /ci/api/openapi.json.

get.summary: Fleet queue: self-hosted runners, hosted pool, and optionally one repo

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository name without the org, e.g. spar

400.description: repo is not a bare repository name

503.description: no ground station configured, or no snapshot received yet

get.summary: Should an agent open a PR of this kind in this repo now?
get.description: security and red-main are always open. docs batch whenever the repo has CI in flight. fix and feature use thresholds kept in warte. Stale data (snapshot older than 5 minutes) never gates: the verdict is open and the reason says so.

400.description: missing or invalid repo or kind

503.description: no ground station configured, or no snapshot received yet

recheck_s.description: Seconds until asking again is worthwhile; absent for open
